description: VAL-21, EXP-39 and VAL-19 expectations shared by the AST tests of every package and by scripts/check-generated-native-calls.mts. Every host renders the templates with the assign entries order, same, other and items: order and same are one host object of the order class, other is a second object of that class and items is the list [1]. Every host registers describe, mutate and pick as host functions, Order::describe as a logical class function, and describe as a public method of the order class. describe returns the description of its arguments, mutate changes its list and map arguments and returns null, and pick returns its argument. A native object has no order (compare.tpl) and no JSON text, also inside a list or a map (json.tpl, FUN-26). A native object is opaque (VAL-19): it is truthy (truthy.tpl), echoing it fails with E_RUNTIME_STRINGIFY (stringify.tpl), and a loop over it (iterate.tpl) and a spread of it (spread.tpl) fail with E_RUNTIME_TYPE.
